title: Godmode Extension Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a godmode extension. Describes one or more interfaces (api / graphql / mcp / command) through which agents can invoke external systems and local programs.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier used as the CLI argument (e.g. 'stripe' in `godmode stripe api`). Defaults to `name` lowercased.

description.description: One-line summary of what the extension provides.

interfaces.description: Map of registered interface-provider name → provider-specific configuration. At least one required.

headers.description: Additional request headers sent with every invocation.

ApiInterface.description: REST (OpenAPI) interface. Resources and routes are derived from the spec.

spec.description: Path or URL to an OpenAPI document (YAML or JSON).

url.description: Base URL. If omitted, inferred from spec.servers[0].url.

GraphqlInterface.description: GraphQL interface. Requires either an SDL file (spec) or an introspectable endpoint (url).

spec.description: Path to a GraphQL SDL (.graphql) file.

url.description: GraphQL endpoint; introspected if spec is not provided.

CommandInterface.description: A local program exposed as subcommands.

run.description: The program, or the program followed by fixed leading arguments. A part written as ./path is resolved against the manifest's folder.

spec.description: Path to a JSON or YAML file holding { version?, commands }.

summary.description: One line for the command list.

description.description: Paragraphs shown in the command's own help.

group.description: Heading the command is listed under.

argv.description: Leading arguments handed to the program. Defaults to [name].

passthrough.description: Hand every argument to the program unchanged, without validation.

positional.description: Passed to the program by position, in declaration order.

repeatable.description: May be given more than once; the last positional may be variadic.

default.description: Documented default; the program applies it.

flag.description: Flag handed to the program. Defaults to --<name>.

Auth.description: Shared authentication config. Applies to every interface unless overridden.
